column5: Every currently translated math builtin is dispatched and implemented by one math-family owner including CONV CRC32 and RAND stable AST identity; ABS signed-minimum overflow and integer TRUNCATE unsigned-scale passthrough plus exact uint64 negative-scale truncation now follow their source signatures, while the untranslated source remainder stays visible. The transcendental and finite EXP/LOG/POW/ROUND/TRUNCATE/CRC32/CONV families have complete representable source-row tables in rust/crates/tidb-expr/src/tests/math.rs; warning-channel and session FieldType behavior remain explicit partial boundaries.
